<!--
How a proposal works

- Discuss in the comments of this Issue. The description may be updated as the discussion goes on
- Record the decision at the end as a single comment. If accepted, open a PR that updates the spec (docs/spec) and close this Issue with that PR (completed). If declined, give the reason and close as not planned
- docs/spec is the source of truth for what was decided; this Issue keeps the history
- Put long research or design documents in the repo and link them from this Issue
-->
